<?php
$curl = curl_init();
curl_setopt_array($curl, [
    CURLOPT_URL => 'https://api.test/pets',
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
    CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Content-Type: application/json', 'Authorization: Bearer [redacted]'],
    CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{"name":"it\'s \\"Rex\\"","n":"line
break","u":"é"}',
]);
$response = curl_exec($curl);
curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
